title: Norwegian Chestnut Kjøttkaker
description: A traditional Norwegian festive dish featuring cooked chestnuts, served with a peppery twist. Perfect for a cozy dinner with family and friends.
instructions: In a large pan, heat 10g of butter over medium heat. Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.

In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground beef, cooked onion and garlic mixture, chestnuts, flour, breadcrumbs, egg, cheddar cheese, black pepper, and salt. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into 8-10 oval-shaped patties.
Place the patties on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch (2.5 cm) of space between each patty.
Dot the top of each patty with the remaining 10g of butter.
Bake the patties in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through and lightly browned on the outside.
Remove the patties from the oven and garnish with chopped parsley.
Serve the Norwegian Chestnut Kjøttkaker hot, with your choice of sides.
